title: Slovakian Wrap with Maple Syrup Glaze
description: A sweet and savory twist on traditional Japanese cuisine. A crispy Slovakian wrap filled with smoky and molten ingredients, topped with a maple syrup glaze.
instructions: Preheat a non-stick pan over medium heat.
Place the Slovakian flatbread wrap in the pan and cook for 2 minutes on each side.
In a separate pan, heat the monsoon spice mix over low heat.
Add the smoked tofu to the spice mix and cook for 2-3 minutes.
Add the molten mozzarella cheese to the tofu and stir until melted.
Place the cooked wrap on a flat surface and add the tofu and cheese mixture.
Drizzle the maple syrup glaze over the top.
Fold the wrap in half and serve immediately.
